campaigns.name: A Most Potent Brew
campaigns.description: A brewing competition turns deadly when a mysterious brew causes chaos.
story: You enter the quiet village of Bramblewood.
The smell of fresh hops fills the air, but something is wrong.
The local brewer, Thoran, looks terrified.
He begs you to investigate the strange brew causing chaos.

campaigns.name: The Wolves of Welton
campaigns.description: Wolves are terrorizing the town of Welton. Discover why they’ve turned violent.
story: The town of Welton is on edge.
Wolves have been attacking livestock and villagers alike.
The mayor offers a reward for discovering the cause.
You set out into the dark forest...

campaigns.name: A Wild Sheep Chase
campaigns.description: A whimsical adventure involving a magical sheep and a frantic chase across the countryside.
story: A magical sheep has escaped from the wizard's tower.
It's causing mayhem across the countryside.
You must catch it before it ruins the harvest!
